rev.t: Dock 66 was an overall okay-okay experience for us. I visited the place with a group of 10 members, and it felt like a decent spot for a one-time visit. …
The restaurant looks really good from the outside and the ground floor ambience is nice ✨, but the first floor was not maintained properly — the wooden flooring felt broken and uncomfortable 🚧. …

Hang out place for friends.
The portion size could have been better and cutleries should be replaced as they were serving in steel bowls which was looking substandard. …
